in_marathi.name: Sharvya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Saraswati is the embodiment of knowledge, music, arts, and wisdom. Sharvya is derived from Saraswati.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Sharvya' is derived from 'Sharada', which is an alternative name for Goddess Saraswati. Saraswati is the goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning. The name 'Sharvya' signifies the grace and blessings of Saraswati.
